note: Routing smoke scenarios. Each prompt is a user moment; expect names the skill the model should route to, or 'none'. Slash-only skills (disable-model-invocation: true) are invisible to the model by design — their scenarios expect 'none' and act as visibility canaries: a run that names one means its disable flag broke. Later packages append their skills' scenarios here.
